text: Before any configuration starts, V1 gets a hard written scope -- what actually ships, and what gets honestly deferred.
V1 ships the Enterprise Structure, five subledgers, role-based security, a working close, and FBDI migration of historical balances.
Oracle's standard financial reports are V1 -- a custom BI or analytics layer on top is a named, deferred V2 idea.
Procurement and Order Management stay untouched beyond what Payables and Receivables need to actually function.
Next: the first real architecture decision -- the Ledger, Legal Entity, and Chart of Accounts.
